widgets: 

Thirteen divines are named individually in the Íqán; my earlier "fourteen" was a slip. Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání is now identified, from Ruhe's *Robe of Light* and the Spanish glossary. For Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí, Nabíl's account and the Spanish glossary find no matching Bábí hero, and only a hostile figure of that name turns up. Each row rests on a passage that describes the man, not on the Íqán list that names him.

| # | Name | Who he was | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Mullá Ḥusayn** (Bushrúyih) | First of the Letters of the Living. He led the Bábís to Fort Ṭabarsí and was shot there by ‘Abbás-Qulí Khán, then buried in the fort. Bahá'u'lláh revealed a Tablet of Visitation for him. | ([A Traveler’s Narrative](https://oceanlibrary.com/travelers-narrative_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_58&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_4d.0~abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_4d.3426); [Tablet of Visitation for Mullá Husayn](http://irfancolloquia.org/38/mccants_wronged)) |
| 2 | **Siyyid Yaḥyá** (Vaḥíd) | Siyyid Yaḥyáy-i-Dárábí, **"that unique and peerless figure of his age"* ([bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes](https://oceanoflights.org/file/bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes.pdf))*. He was the hero of the Nayríz upheaval in Fárs and fell as a victim of its flames. | ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_107&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_5q.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_5q.1544)); Balyuzi's view: (Bahá’u’lláh, a Brief Life -and- The Word Made Flesh) |
| 3 | **Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání** (Ḥujjat) | A Zanján mujtahid. On reading the Báb's writings he abandoned his lecture-room and called his disciples to the Báb. Shoghi Effendi calls him a vehement controversialist, of bold and independent mind. | ([A Traveler’s Narrative](https://oceanlibrary.com/travelers-narrative_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_15&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.0~abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.282); [God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_42&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.897)) |
| 4 | **Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Basṭámí** | A Letter of the Living. He proclaimed the Báb before Shaykh Muḥammad-Ḥasan in Najaf and was then excommunicated, chained and imprisoned. Shoghi Effendi calls him *"the first to suffer"* for the Báb. Balyuzi calls him the first Bábí martyr. | ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_39&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.1230)); Balyuzi: (The Báb - The Herald of the Days) |
| 5 | **Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí** | Not identified in the library (searched: Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí, Mulla Said Barfurushi, Sa‘íd Bárfurúsh with Ṭabarsí, Mázindarán). Fáḍil Mázandarání writes of a Mullá Sa‘íd's cruelty toward Quddús at Bárfurúsh. That is a hostile mullá, and nothing shows he is the same man. | (Ẓuhúru'l-Ḥaqq Vol 3 (Babi Biographies)) |
| 6 | **Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Mázindarání** | A Bábí believer martyred at Shaykh Ṭabarsí, according to the glossary of the Spanish edition. | ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |
| 7 | **Mullá Yúsuf-i-Ardibílí** | A Letter of the Living, noted for learning, enthusiasm and eloquence. In Kirmán his eloquence alarmed Ḥájí Karím Khán. | ([shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=149.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Y%C3%BAs%C3%BAf%2Di%2DArdib%C3%ADl%C3%AD%2C%20one,the%20battle%20of%20Vas%2DKas)) |
| 8 | **Mullá Mihdíy-i-Khu'í** | The Spanish glossary calls him a close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and tutor to the children of His household, martyred at Ṭabarsí. That wording matches Shoghi Effendi's note on Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí, so treat it as unsettled. Nabíl notes a Letter of the Living, Mullá Maḥmúd-i-Khú'í, as brother of a Mullá Mihdí. | ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all); [shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=148.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Ma%E1%B8%A5m%C3%BAd%2Di%2DKh%C3%BA%E2%80%99%C3%AD%2C%20brother,and%20a%20distinguished%20divine)) |
| 9 | **Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí** | Not identified in the library (searched: Turshízí, Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí, Turshiz). The Báb's amanuensis was Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Yazdí, called ‘Azíz, a different man. | ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_169&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_7g.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_7g.803)) |
| 10 | **Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí** | A close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and tutor to the children of His household. | ([shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=152.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Mihd%C3%ADy%2Di%2DKand%C3%AD%2C%20a,children%20of%20His%20household)) |
| 11 | **Mullá Báqir** | Brother of Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí and martyred at Ṭabarsí, per the Spanish glossary. | ([Glosario Basico de Terminos Baha'is](https://bahai-library.com/glosario_basico_terminos_bahais)) |
| 12 | **Mullá ‘Abdu'l-Kháliq-i-Yazdí** | Formerly a Jewish priest. He accepted Islám, joined the Shaykhí school, and was converted by Mullá Ḥusayn, per the Spanish glossary. The Báb addressed a tablet to him. | ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=3); [all items by The Báb, summary](https://bahai-library.com/inventory/BB)) |
| 13 | **Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání** | A Qazvín cleric from the village of Baraghan, brother of Mullá Taqí and Mullá Ṣáliḥ and so uncle of Ṭáhirih. Ruhe writes that he became a follower of Siyyid Káẓim of Rasht. The Spanish glossary adds that he became one of the most active Bábí expositors in Ṭihrán. | (Robe of Light: The Persian Years of the Supreme Prophet Bahá'u'lláh 18…; [Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |

**Not settled**
- Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí and Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí remain unidentified in the library.
- The rows resting on the Spanish glossary (6, 8, 11, 12, and the Ṭihrán detail in 13) are a published glossary's notes, not Bahá'u'lláh's words. Check them against the Íqán's English notes before citing in a paper.
- On row 13, Ṭáhirih's uncle Mullá Taqí is the Qazvín Imám-Jum‘ih ([Memorials of the Faithful](https://oceanlibrary.com/memorials-of-the-faithful_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_684&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-memorials-of-the-faithful_en_no.0~abdu-l-baha-memorials-of-the-faithful_en_no.482)), so the family tie to Mullá Ṣáliḥ and Ṭáhirih comes from Ruhe and the glossary, not from ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's text.
